quest.title: Upon the Plain, a Purple Shadow
quest.description: You and Paimon travel near Byakko Plain on your journey...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x475, Mora x31125, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x7

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's been a while since we first set foot on Inazuma!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So many things have happened since then.

choices.text: As if in the blink of an eye...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah. We've definitely made some progress on our journey.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So, where should we go today?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Wait a moment.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? What's up?

choices.text: There have been many memorable events.

dialogues.text: Huh? So you don't have a Vision after all.
Seems like I've mistaken you for someone else.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: At the very least, you should make sure you've got the right person before you go attacking them!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, wait... even when you've got the right person, you shouldn't go attacking them out of the blue! It's dangerous!
Have you ever met someone by the name of Kaedehara Kazuha?
He carries a sword, just like you. I've also heard that he possesses an Anemo Vision.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why are you looking for him?
That's none of your business.
Hmph, never mind. You don't look like you know anything anyway. I'm wasting my time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What the heck is this guy's problem? Coming around here, waving that weird sword in our faces... and didn't even apologize! Seems like a real nutcase.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, one thing's for sure... No way are we telling him anything about Kazuha.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right? Paimon has a feeling though, that even if this guy gets to challenge Kazuha to a duel, he won't be able to beat him.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, just to be on the safe side, we should go find Kazuha right away and tell him to watch his back.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Actually, I have a hunch...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh? What kind of hunch?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I think this guy may have a special connection to Kazuha.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: A special connection? You mean, beyond already knowing each other?

choices.text: I can't say for sure, but...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, yeah, maybe a little... But then again, most people look pretty much the same once they start fighting, so that doesn't really prove anything...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Anyway, there's no time to lose — let's go tell Kazuha, so he won't get into any danger!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon heard that the Crux Fleet is stocking up in Ritou at the moment. Let's look for him there.

choices.text: ...I feel like their fighting styles are kind of similar.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, don't be mean. Paimon's smart lots of the time!

talks.objective: Go to Ritou and look for Kazuha

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, hello! Do you know where Kazuha is?

dialogues.speaker: Chao
dialogues.text: You're looking for Kazuha too, huh? Guess he must've done something impressive after all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "Too"?

dialogues.speaker: Chao
dialogues.text: Hahaha, well, we took the small vessels into Ritou on a routine supply run — only this time, as soon as we entered the harbor, we ran into a huge crowd of Inazumans, all of them wanting to know about Kazuha.

dialogues.speaker: Chao
dialogues.text: If it's because of that battle on Nazuchi Beach, Captain Beidou had a great run there too, but I don't see her getting this kind of attention!

dialogues.speaker: Chao
dialogues.text: Kazuha keeps to himself most of the time. In fact, there are times when he doesn't even listen to the captain, but she just laughs it off...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh? So, you still don't know what he did.

dialogues.speaker: Chao
dialogues.text: I've heard bits and pieces. Something about him blocking the Raiden Shogun's "Musou no Hitotachi."

dialogues.speaker: Chao
dialogues.text: Is it really as big a deal as everyone's making it out to be?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You could compare it to the technique Beidou used to strike down Haishan.

dialogues.speaker: Chao
dialogues.text: Really? Wow, when you put it like that, it all makes sense. Hahaha, in that case, his new-found stardom is well-deserved!

dialogues.speaker: Chao
dialogues.text: He was called away earlier by some people from the Tenryou Commission. They said they had something important to discuss with him.

dialogues.speaker: Chao
dialogues.text: I thought they'd come to arrest him at first... turns out they couldn't have been friendlier to him. Seems like they really respect the guy.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Just a little while ago, this would have been completely unimaginable...

choices.text: The Shogunate probably wants to show some goodwill.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Thank you! Guess we'll go pay a visit to the Tenryou Commission.

response.speaker: Chao
response.text: Alright then. I'll just stay here and carry on trying to fend off the crowd.

choices.text: After all, the Raiden Shogun's mindset has changed.

talks.objective: Go to the Tenryou Commission Headquarters

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: #Oh? It's you, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Greetings. We were just discussing the repealing of the Vision Hunt Decree. Since you're here, you're very welcome to listen in on the conversation.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: We invited Mr. Kaedehara here to extend a gesture of goodwill on behalf of the Shogunate.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Your hard work has secured for us the agreeable state of affairs that we now enjoy. Also, I have been granted the chance to correct my clan's past mistakes, and for that, I am deeply grateful.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: The Almighty Shogun has issued a large array of directives aimed at resolving, or at least easing, the tensions that have built up over the years.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: The Tri-Commission has made the recommendation to use this opportunity to restore the honor of the Kaedehara name.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
dialogues.text: Regarding the history of the Kaedehara Clan... I trust that you are already somewhat informed?

choices.text: I've heard a thing or two.

response.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
response.text: In short, there once was a group of select bladesmiths who served the Shogun directly, responsible for upholding and further developing the traditional blade-forging arts of the Almighty Shogun. The Kaedehara Clan belonged to this class.

response.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
response.text: But there came a time when some of these bladesmiths revolted and fled to Snezhnaya. Both the Kaedehara and Kamisato Clans were held accountable for lax oversight, and entered a period of great turmoil.

response.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
response.text: We later learned that the whole misadventure had been secretly orchestrated by the Fatui. Attributing all of the blame to the Kamisato and Kaedehara Clans was neither proper, nor just.

response.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
response.text: Considering Mr. Kaedehara has once more made an outstanding contribution to Inazuma, the Almighty Shogun believes he should not only be rewarded for his achievements, but also receive recompense for the excessive punishment borne by his clan in the past.

response.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
response.text: In the interest of preventing further harassment of the bladesmith clans by the Fatui, we chose not to publicly release the findings of our investigations into these matters. We trust you can understand why this was necessary.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: This is a true honor. I am delighted to be in a position to receive the goodwill of the Almighty Shogun and the Shogunate at large.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: However... would I be correct to assume that this magnanimous gesture does not come without some strings attached?

response.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
response.text: I can assure you that nothing could be further from the truth. We seek only to correct a past injustice.

response.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
response.text: With the Kaedehara Clan's reputation and occupation restored, the Kaedeharas will be bladesmiths once more, and your wanderings will finally come to an end.

response.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
response.text: You will be able to lead a safe and prosperous life in Inazuma City with the Almighty Shogun's blessing and the full support of the Shogunate.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: I have grown accustomed to life among the elements, I fear I would no longer feel at home behind the tall walls of a stately abode.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Yet my ancestors did indeed take great pride in the name of Kaedehara and the art of blademaking for which it stood. I do have a responsibility to restore their honor.

response.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
response.text: I sense some hesitation in your words.

response.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
response.text: Should you accept this offer, I imagine many of the malicious rumors currently circulating through the populace will disappear.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Malicious rumors? All we heard on the way here was so much praise that we almost wondered whether there was another Kaedehara Kazuha in town.

response.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
response.text: Well, to some, the Musou no Hitotachi is something that can never be defeated. They cannot accept the idea that Mr. Kaedehara really parried the Shogun's strike.

response.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
response.text: Also, eye-witnesses saw him using the power of Electro in addition to that of Anemo. As a result, the falsehood that "Kaedehara Kazuha was using a Delusion" began to spread...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What? But that doesn't make sense. Using a Delusion turns you old and frail, and Kazuha still looks fine...

response.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
response.text: That is correct. However, to some people, the idea of a single person wielding two elements at once is a more inconceivable notion still.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: This is just one of many similar rumors. I am very uncomfortable with being the subject of public discussion, no matter whether it brings suspicion or stardom my way.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: But perhaps, if the Shogunate is willing to publicly support me, this situation will blow over more quickly...

response.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
response.text: This is precisely why I'd encourage you to give our offer some serious thought. It stands to benefit all of us.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Hmm. Please allow me some time to consider.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: In fact, let us put this discussion on hold for the moment. Well then, what brings the two of you here?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yikes, we nearly forgot about the most important thing!

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You and Paimon recount the attack on the outskirts of town to Kazuha.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Why would such a dangerous individual be looking for me...?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: No. This puzzles me as much as it does you.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: My fighting forms were taught to me by my family, based on techniques originally developed for blade-testing. We undergo rigorous training to standardize every motion the blade is put through, so that each can be fairly assessed for quality.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Over time, these techniques came to form something of a Kaedehara sword art, focused on blade-testing but with a full repertoire of combat forms.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Those forms are quite different from the more practical ones typically used by samurai in battle, so it's hard to imagine that the similarity you speak of was coincidence alone...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: All the more reason to watch your back! This guy was a serious nutcase.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Indeed. He sounds highly aggressive. Anyone he targets is at risk of serious injury, or worse.

response.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
response.text: In that case, I will send some men out immediately to search for him.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Thank you. I must say, I am now very curious about this matter, and I will also need some time to consider your offer.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: #I will first join the Traveler in investigating the one who attacked {M#him}{F#her}, then give you a conclusive answer upon my return.

response.speaker: Kujou Kamaji
response.text: Very well. Please stay safe.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Come on. Let's go and track down your aggressor.

choices.text: Could it be someone you trained with under the same master?

dialogues.speaker: Ryouhei
dialogues.text: I heard that that guy who took on the Musou no Hitotachi is actually working as a sailor with the Crux Fleet...

dialogues.speaker: Chiaki
dialogues.text: Eh? Wasn't he from Watatsumi Island's army?

dialogues.speaker: Asano
dialogues.text: He still hasn't arrived? Come on, Kaedehara Kazuha...

dialogues.speaker: Nosaki
dialogues.text: All I want is to see our hero with my own eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Taketani
dialogues.text: I gotta interview him today... I have to...

dialogues.speaker: Chao
dialogues.text: With all this going on, I sure hope no one tries to sneak onto the ship...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Detective Agency knows the most about what goes on in town.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's see what Ryuuji has to say!
